description.content:
Add and remove members in one request. For example, remove user A and add user B. You can add or remove up to 500 users at a time.

Required scope

organizations:groups:write

Rate limiting

Level 1 per item. For example, if you want to add 10 users and remove 5, the rate limiting applicable will be 750 credits. This is because each user addition or deletion takes Level 1 rate limiting of 50 credits, so 15 * 50 = 750.

Enterprise only

This API is available only for Enterprise plan users. You can only use this endpoint if you have the role of a Company Admin. You can request temporary access to Enterprise APIs using this form.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of an organization.
(Required) The ID of a user group.

response.name:
Results for adding or removing members of a user group.
Note that adding users might succeed partially. In this case, the array of responses contains two objects with operation set to "addMembers": one for the successfully added members, and one explaining why the operation failed for the remaining members.
